name: Transparent Pudding
description: Historical recipe from The Virginia Housewife; Or, Methodical Cook (1824). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: pounded sugar
ingredients.originalText: half a pound of pounded sugar

ingredients.name: fresh butter melted
ingredients.originalText: half a pound of fresh butter melted

instructions.text: Add half a pound of pounded sugar, the same of fresh butter melted, and half a nutmeg grated
Sit it on a stove, and keep stirring till it is as thick as buttered eggs
Put a puff paste in a shallow dish, pour in the ingredients, and bake it half an hour in a moderate oven
Sift sugar over it, and serve it up hot

source.author: Mary Randolph
source.originalInstructions:
1. Beat eight eggs very light
2. Add half a pound of pounded sugar, the same of fresh butter melted, and half a nutmeg grated
3. Sit it on a stove, and keep stirring till it is as thick as buttered eggs
4. Put a puff paste in a shallow dish, pour in the ingredients, and bake it half an hour in a moderate oven
5. Sift sugar over it, and serve it up hot
